messages:
Priya: Quick PSA  I clicked through the onboarding notebook and a link to docs/observability/tracing#span-ids 404s (page exists, fragment not found).
Omar: Confirmed. The heading was renamed to `Trace identifiers` in the recent copy refresh, so the old anchor vanished.
Priya: That notebook is used in next-week new-hire class. Can we add a compatibility alias (frontmatter) or an explicit HTML anchor? Frontmatter alias preferred.
Jules: I can prep a micro-PR. Plan: add `aliases` to observability/tracing.md and run a repo-wide replace for any hard-coded `#span-ids` refs.
Omar: FYI I found 5 hits with rg: `handbook/onboarding/new-hire.ipynb`, `runtime/guide/tracing.md`, `examples/obs/demo.ipynb`, `scripts/verify-links.sh`, `assets/slides/tracing.html`.
Priya: Can you include a tiny automated check in CI that fails if a link to observability/tracing#span-ids returns non-200? That'll prevent regressions when headings are rewritten.
Jules: Good idea. I'll add a link-smoke test (curl + grep for anchor fragment) in the docs CI job. Example snippet I'll use in the PR description: 

curl -sS https://docs.redwood.inference/observability/tracing | grep -q "id=\"span-ids\"" || echo "anchor-missing" && exit 1

Omar: Small note: client-side routers sometimes rewrite anchors; frontmatter alias is safer since static site will emit a redirect.
Jules: Agree. I'll add frontmatter aliases and also emit a raw HTML anchor for good measure.
link-bot: Quick check queued: running link-scan over the repo for `#span-ids` occurrences...
link-bot: Found 5 occurrences, creating suggested patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2399
Priya: Thanks. Can QA-team add a short verification in the onboarding checklist to click that notebook link after merge?
QA-team: Will do. Add `docs: add alias + anchor for tracing span-ids (fixes onboarding notebook)` to the changelog entry please. We'll validate after CI.
Omar: PR opened and requested review from @Priya and @QA-team. Will hold ownership for 48h to monitor CI/link-check.
Priya: Fast-track ok for this small change once link-check passes. Thanks everyone.
